subject: Post-demo: Stakeholder map + security scope clarifications for Ava Health
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@avahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + action items (stakeholders & systems in scope)

Hi Emily — thanks again for taking the demo with the team this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

What we covered:
- Demo: hosted API + Dedicated capacity options, logging/audit features, and the Redwood Console for per-route observability.
- Typical landing pattern we see at midsize health systems: pilot with a single patient-facing workflow, then scale with Dedicated or Private for PHI-sensitive flows.

Open items we need to lock down from your side:
1) Economic decision owner (title + contact) — who signs contracts / approves spend?
2) Security / legal entry point — does your security team run the questionnaire or do you have a procurement intake that fields evidence requests?
3) Systems in scope for the review — e.g., EHR integration, patient portal, analytics pipeline, identity provider (IdP).

Attached is a short security questionnaire we prefer to start with (Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx). If you can return the questionnaire and a rough list of systems in scope, we’ll line up a focused kickoff with our security engineer and solutions architect.

Proposed next step: 30–45m security kickoff on Wed Apr 1 or Thu Apr 2. Which day works for your security/infra folks?

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben for procurement questions if/when we get the econ buyer.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@avahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Security <security@avahealth.com>, Procurement <procure@avahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + action items (stakeholders & systems in scope)

Hi Vivek — great demo, thanks. A few quick answers: 

- Economic owner: Jordan Miles (VP of Digital Transformation) — jordan.miles@avahealth.com. He handles vendor approvals and budget sign-off.
- Security contact: @IT Security (security@avahealth.com) will own the questionnaire. I’ve CC’d them.
- Systems in scope: patient portal (portal.avahealth.com), data lake (aws account: ava-analytics), and the AuthN/AuthZ flow via Okta. Note that any PHI flows must go through our Protected Processing lane; we can scope a narrow pilot to keep PHI out of the hosted environment for the first 90 days.

We’ll take a pass on the questionnaire and return it by EOD Wed. Wed Apr 1 is tight for the security team, Thu Apr 2 afternoon looks better for a kickoff (1:30–3:00pm PT).

Emily Chen
Head of Product — Digital Services
Ava Health
emily.chen@avahealth.com

Attachment: ava-network-diagram.png (sent separately)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo recap + action items (stakeholders & systems in scope)

Noted — good initial scope. A couple of internal items before kickoff: 

- Prep ask for security kickoff (for our security engineer): a short list of in-scope endpoints and whether any lookups will contain PHI. That helps us pre-run threat model notes and bring the right folks (network + SRE).
- Pricing note: if we end up needing Private deployment for PHI within 90 days, we should be ready with a high-level T-shirt estimate to keep the conversation moving. I can draft that after we see questionnaire results.

Also recommend we propose a mutual action plan in the kickoff: acceptance criteria for the pilot (latency targets, token ceilings, data residency), timeline, and procurement milestones (PO, legal review). I’ll draft MAP and drop in the HubSpot deal record after the call.

—Laura
Director, Solutions + GTM | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@avahealth.com>, Procurement <procure@avahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + action items (stakeholders & systems in scope)

Emily / Procurement — thanks for the quick turnaround. Two procurement items while your team reviews the questionnaire: 

1) Standard PO flow we use for pilots: 3-month pilot subscription invoiced monthly. If you need a quote or SOW ahead of legal review, say the word and I’ll generate a stub.
2) If Jordan needs a one-pager for budget approval, I can prepare a short ROI summary (estimated token spend at pilot scale + expected unit-cost delta vs current setup).

Looping procurement to confirm billing contact and tax/jurisdiction info.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: (none)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@avahealth.com>, IT Security <security@avahealth.com>, Procurement <procure@avahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + action items (stakeholders & systems in scope)

Thanks all — confirming Thu Apr 2 at 1:30pm PT for the security kickoff.

Agenda (30–45m):
- Introductions & goals (5m)
- Systems in scope review: portal, data lake, Okta, integration points (10m)
- Questionnaire walkthrough + evidence note list (10m)
- Pilot scope & MAP milestones (10m)

Prep requested from Ava: completed questionnaire PDF + the network diagram Emily mentioned (ava-network-diagram.png). If procurement can share the billing contact and any internal PO timelines that would be helpful for MAP milestone alignment.

I’ll drop a calendar invite with the DocuSign link for our standard NDA and the HubSpot deal link. Looking forward to a focused kickoff.

Best,
Vivek
